message: Build a small JSON notes API. Python standard library only; no runtime network assets or build step. Serve on 127.0.0.1 using python server.py --port PORT --store PATH (JSON file, initially absent). GET /api/notes returns a JSON array, initially []; POST /api/notes with {"text":"..."} creates a note (201) and returns {"id":integer,"text":text}; GET /api/notes/ID returns that note; DELETE /api/notes/ID returns 204. Text must be nonempty, at most 200 characters. IDs are unique and stable. File-store data survives restart. Invalid or malformed JSON returns 400 with a nonempty JSON error string; unknown resource returns 404. README.md explains startup.

profile.platform: Windows, Python 3 standard library; desktop and mobile browser
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network assets, deployment or paid services.
